newsitem.title: UK: Energis may link up with cable cos-paper.
newsitem.headline: Energis may link up with cable cos-paper.

text.p: Energis, the fledgling telecoms group owned by the National Grid Plc, is considering plans to form alliances with UK cable companies to give the network better access to local business customers, a paper said on Monday.
The Independent newspaper said Energis chief executive Mike Grabiner declined to comment on which cable companies would take part but said discussions were taking place with most firms.
"We haven't ruled anything out or walked away from anything," the paper quoted him as saying.

The paper said the deal could cost up to 50 million pounds in additional investment. Last week, Energis sparked a call price battle by slashing international charges to five of the most popular destinations from the UK. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7715
